fusions.name: Thrown and Fetched
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill fetches one back. Your hound runs at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 8 damage to it, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and brings it down in a blow that deals 14 damage, leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds and makes it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rounding Up
fusions.desc: Draws up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. For 8 seconds your hound runs beside you and bites a nearby enemy for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hound at the Axle
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your hound bites the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
